mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 72 degrees with partly cloudy conditions at Badger Prairie County Park.

In city news, the Verona Police Department is hosting a nine week Citizen Academy starting September 23 to foster community relations, while bridge construction is set to close the Military Ridge State Trail between Lincoln and South Franklin Streets starting September 14.
Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness or trivia at Hop Haus, and tomorrow brings live music to both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

On Sunday, August 30, the Verona Police Department initiated an arrest of a 34-year-old Madison resident following an investigation into an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student that occurred back in 2019.
Today is the perfect day to stop by Culver's for the Dark Chocolate Decadence flavor of the day. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight.
